config.notes: Remote Linear MCP server. No API key is required: on first connection your client opens a browser to authorize access to your Linear workspace via OAuth. Provides tools to manage Linear issues, projects, and teams.

installConfigs.instructions: No API key is required: on first connection Theia opens a browser to authorize access to your Linear workspace via OAuth, then stores the resulting token automatically.
